description: This file implements a header field table for HPACK compression used in HTTP/2, including data structures, methods for managing header entries, and Huffman coding tables.

classes.name: headerFieldTable
classes.description: A data structure managing static and dynamic header tables for HPACK compression, including methods for adding, evicting, and searching header fields.

methods.name: len
methods.description: Returns the number of header entries in the table.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a new HeaderField entry to the table.

methods.name: evictOldest
methods.description: Removes the oldest entries from the table.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for a HeaderField in the table, returning its index and whether the value matches.

methods.name: idToIndex
methods.description: Converts a unique id to an HPACK index, considering static or dynamic table.
